stem: Which statement expresses a main theme of the play?

options.label: A
options.text: Writing can be a helpful way to deal with stress.

options.label: B
options.text: Keeping secrets can lead to problems in a relationship.

options.label: C
options.text: It is best to apologize when something wrong has been done.

options.label: D
options.text: People must make time for one another in order for relationships to thrive.
